question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"legitimately**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"legitimately"** means in a way that conforms to the law or to rules. (वैध रूप से)

 
 
• Example: *There are times when you **legitimately**__ need to cancel travel plans.*
 
 The paragraph conveys that even though Indian athletes had demonstrated enough promise to rightfully anticipate a significant medal comeback at the Games, the setbacks from Rio 2016 persisted.
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.
 
• Correct paragraph: 

The build up to the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, which __began__ on July 23 and finished on August 8, as defined by cautious optimism, as well as a slew of __anxiety__ that came with staging the Games under tight safety standards and without __spectators__ during the COVID-19 outbreak. While Indian competitors had shown enough potential to __**legitimately**__ expect a big return of medals in the Games, the disappointments of Rio 2016 lingered. What happened was that India delivered its best-ever performance at the Games, beginning with Mirabai Chanu's silver medal in weightlifting on the first day and culminating with Neeraj Chopra's ______ (5) ______ gold medal in javelin throw on the country's last day of competition in Tokyo.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Casually: **in a relaxed and informal way. (अनौपचारिक रूप से; लापरवाही से; अकस्‍मात)
 
• **Constitutionally: **in accordance with one's constitution. (संवैधानिक रूप से)
 
• **Authoritatively: **in a way that is trusted as being accurate or true; with authority. (एक तरह से जिसके सटीक या सत्य होने पर भरोसा किया जाता है; अधिकार के साथ)
